name: Arc Drake
description: A creature type for flying reptiles similar to dragons but smaller and less powerful, with wings replacing one set of limbs.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn attacks Leighbet with electricity and declares the serum a Dimir discovery; an arc drake's electric breath hits them in the water.
timeline.quote: your serum is a Dimir discovery now. Goodbye, Leighbet.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: The drakes of the Kapsho Sea ally with Talrand against the dragons.
timeline.quote: the drakes of the Kapsho Sea have allied with the hydromancer Talrand against the dragons that used to tyrannize the sea.
